instruction:
Task: Drag a content block handle and drop the block into a new position between two other existing blocks.
Expected Result: The block is visually moved and re-inserted at the new position, and other blocks adjust accordingly.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
